license.reuse_condition_summary: Preserve the copyright and permission notice in copies or substantial portions; perform Mastermind dependency, provenance, security, and compatibility review independently.

decision_vocabulary.ADOPT_PATTERN: Reuse the interaction or contract idea with original Mastermind implementation unless exact source reuse is independently justified.
decision_vocabulary.ADAPT_COMPONENT: A bounded source component may be evaluated or reused behind an existing Mastermind owner after immutable pin, license, SBOM, tests, and security review.
decision_vocabulary.DEBUG_ONLY: Useful only as disposable local diagnostic evidence, never as canonical company state or production authority.
decision_vocabulary.REJECT_AS_AUTHORITY: May not own Mastermind lifecycle, identity, memory, retry, priority, session, or permission truth.
decision_vocabulary.REJECT_FOR_LIVE_SEATS: Do not enable on Chairman or production seats without a later explicit architecture and proof decision.
decision_vocabulary.REQUIRES_FALSIFIER: Value or safety must be established through the named bounded test before adoption.

entries.observed_shape: Core and Desktop are separate discovery surfaces; Core groups read/image/patch/terminal/session/agent tools and Desktop groups observe/computer.
entries.mastermind_owner: Sol Capability Fabric and each existing app/tool owner
entries.integration: Keep Steward, Executive, Dialogue, Surface, worker workbench, and Admin separately versioned. Load only task-relevant families.
entries.do_not_copy: Do not collapse Mastermind's owner-specific public contracts into the upstream Core surface.
entries.proof_required: Actual ChatGPT tool-discovery and schema-cost benchmark with no lower tool-selection or authority accuracy.

entries.feature: familiar read, image, patch, exec, and continue semantics
entries.observed_shape: Tool vocabulary is close to coding-agent workbenches and supports ongoing process interaction.
entries.mastermind_owner: existing worker provider/runtime, Code Intelligence, Source Continuity
entries.integration: Expose bounded worker-local operations derived from the current Attempt/worktree/command policy, not a generic CEO command tool.
entries.do_not_copy: Do not accept arbitrary repository roots, executables, branches, credentials, or runtime bindings from model input.
entries.proof_required: One exact-worktree patch/build/test journey, process reconnect, cancellation distinction, strict result boundary, and zero survivor.

entries.observed_shape: File-oriented operations expose configured workspace roots, but this is not the shell isolation boundary.
entries.mastermind_owner: existing worker sandbox and host security
entries.integration: Use exact Attempt-owned roots, realpath/symlink containment, file type/size limits, binary handling, and invocation-time permissions.
entries.do_not_copy: Never describe a root allowlist as proof that a general shell or desktop action is sandboxed.
entries.proof_required: Synthetic path traversal, symlink, rename/race, forbidden root, large/binary, and permission-revocation tests under the actual OS boundary.

entries.observed_shape: Commands run with the logged-in user's normal privileges and are intentionally not confined to approved folders; the project contains shell-specific repair and guidance logic.
entries.mastermind_owner: existing provider/Attempt process and sandbox owner
entries.integration: Where needed, implement reviewed command families or place arbitrary shell inside a dedicated isolated worker boundary with least-privilege environment and cleanup.
entries.do_not_copy: No unrestricted terminal for Chairman/CEO chats and no broad interactive-user privilege presented as autonomous safety.
entries.proof_required: OS-level containment, network/environment/credential controls, process group and survivor evidence, and exact command/effect attribution.

entries.feature: ongoing process handles and output deltas
entries.observed_shape: A command may return a session identifier for continued interaction rather than blocking one call until completion.
entries.mastermind_owner: Executive Attempt/Worker and existing provider process owner
entries.integration: Bind the provider/process handle to the canonical Attempt, exact workspace, command policy, output cursor, terminal state, cancellation and cleanup.
entries.do_not_copy: Do not create a plugin task/process registry or launch a replacement when the existing handle is temporarily unavailable.
entries.proof_required: Disconnect/reconnect, one-launch count, partial output, terminal exit, cancellation requested versus terminated, restart and cleanup.

entries.feature: batched reads, bounded output, and cursors
entries.observed_shape: The project emphasizes reducing repeated tool calls and constraining model-visible results.
entries.mastermind_owner: Steward, GitHub/CodeIntel, and each immutable evidence owner
entries.integration: Batch exact immutable evidence, use owner-authored opaque continuations, emit coverage and truncation explicitly, and preserve decisive fields.
entries.do_not_copy: Do not change a frozen public schema silently or hide blockers/effect state through compaction.
entries.proof_required: Matched workflow benchmark, strict final-byte validation, invalid late data, missing coverage, and decisive-field retention.

entries.observed_shape: Runtime permissions are intended to gate calls even if a chat retains an older discovered schema.
entries.integration: Every action rechecks current app policy, resource scope, Attempt/binding, source and host permission; cached schema metadata grants no continued access.
entries.do_not_copy: Do not centralize all permissions in a new plugin-owned registry.
entries.proof_required: Permission revoke/restore between discovery and invocation, stale connection, process restart, and no-effect refusal.

entries.feature: desktop observation and action bound to recent state
entries.observed_shape: Desktop capabilities are separately gated and current source supports compatible Windows/macOS families; observation precedes bounded computer actions.
entries.mastermind_owner: Worker Browser / Web-Sol / approved computer-use provider under their existing boundaries
entries.integration: Use recent-observation identity, exact approved app/window/profile, expected precondition, closed action and partial-effect reporting in disposable environments.
entries.do_not_copy: No generic click/type/JavaScript/transcript/account-selection surface for persistent Chairman seats.
entries.proof_required: Stale target, window change, coordinate/control mismatch, partial batch, cross-profile isolation, restart and secret-screen exclusion.

entries.observed_shape: Clipboard reads/writes are part of the optional Desktop surface.
entries.mastermind_owner: approved computer-use provider and host security
entries.integration: Keep independently permissioned and default disabled; use only for a reviewed non-secret disposable workflow when another structured channel is unavailable.
entries.do_not_copy: Never use the clipboard for tokens, credentials, Keychain material, or hidden cross-application data transfer.
entries.proof_required: Default denial, explicit narrow enablement, content classification, revoke behavior and cleanup.

entries.observed_shape: The extension/app records ChatGPT session and tool events for local lookup; project documentation distinguishes completed, failed, stopped, stalled and unknown turn outcomes.
entries.mastermind_owner: Agent OS for durable organization, GitHub for evidence; any local recording remains host diagnostic only
entries.integration: At most use bounded, retention-limited, secret-excluding recordings for disposable debugging and adapter diagnosis.
entries.do_not_copy: No transcript memory database, workstream state, semantic ACK, lifecycle, completion, or succession authority.
entries.proof_required: Recording disabled-by-default or explicit consent, retention/deletion, cross-session isolation, secret and private-page exclusion, restart, and proof that canonical recovery does not depend on it.

entries.observed_shape: The project combines page-internal and DOM signals and deliberately treats unexplained detach as unknown rather than successful completion.
entries.mastermind_owner: Web-Sol/session-health observation; Dialogue and Executive remain semantic/lifecycle owners
entries.integration: Use browser signals as bounded surface-health evidence and preserve UNKNOWN; corroborate with exact owner receipts before semantic or modifying continuation.
entries.do_not_copy: Do not convert visible prose, missing Stop button, Fiber status, or quiet tools into PICKUP_ACK, START, RESULT, context exhaustion, or authority.
entries.proof_required: Provider UI/version variation, detach/reopen reconciliation, partial answer, error banner, user stop, long tool call and stale-page cases.

entries.observed_shape: The project can create and coordinate multiple ChatGPT conversations as prime/worker roles.
entries.mastermind_owner: Executive OS, Capacity, RuntimeBinding, Chat-native hierarchy, provider-specific child execution
entries.integration: A provider may implement bounded child execution after an existing admitted operation and exact placement. Map provider conversations to current owner receipts rather than adopting its registry.
entries.do_not_copy: No second Job/Worker/session lifecycle, quota router, task queue, prime election, or model-created successor program.
entries.proof_required: Bounded concurrency/depth, exact assignment, no path collision, attributable outputs, cleanup, no self-created operation, and current parent consumption.

entries.observed_shape: A separate model may evaluate prior user/final-answer content and submit follow-up prompts for continued work.
entries.mastermind_owner: Executive OS, Agent OS, Wake/Dialogue, exact Chat continuation owners
entries.integration: Use deterministic material events and current canonical state to decide whether reasoning is required; any model recommendation is advisory and separately admitted.
entries.do_not_copy: No free-running arbitrary prompt loop, completion judgment from final prose alone, or third-party model receiving company context without a separate approved data/budget decision.
entries.proof_required: Not eligible for production adoption absent a new explicit architecture ruling and complete provider/data/budget/security proof.

entries.observed_shape: The project can create a compressed continuation across conversations.
entries.mastermind_owner: Agent OS continuation, current context composition, Web-Sol CR ladder and RuntimeBinding
entries.integration: Preserve decision/evidence/next-action packets and exact successor semantics through existing owners. Use model summaries only as attributed synthesis.
entries.do_not_copy: No compaction output as canonical memory, effect truth, target identity, semantic readiness, or binding transfer.
entries.proof_required: Dead predecessor, omitted blocker/effect, contradictory source, duplicate successor, lost submit and stale revival cases.

entries.observed_shape: A localhost bridge connects the extension and desktop application and records/labels ChatGPT activity.
entries.mastermind_owner: existing Web-Sol native host/extension, worker browser provider, host security
entries.integration: Reuse only a bounded transport or observation technique that fills a measured gap in the existing native host; preserve exact profile/session and closed protocol laws.
entries.do_not_copy: No second live-seat extension/native bridge, localhost trust assumption, transcript export, or generic browser control plane.
entries.proof_required: Port binding, authentication, origin, replay, extension update/restart, cross-profile, untrusted local process, payload bound, secret leakage and rollback tests.

entries.observed_shape: Current source contains Windows/macOS capability gates while one inspected security statement was stale about macOS support.
entries.mastermind_owner: approved computer-use provider and host release owner
entries.integration: Treat documentation as hypothesis; pin the actual build and prove each supported host/profile class independently.
entries.do_not_copy: No fleet support claim from source branching or one host canary.
entries.proof_required: Exact OS/release, permission ceremony, input behavior, display/window variations, swapped buttons where relevant, restart and rollback.

entries.observed_shape: A historical snapshot separates expected RED validation events from quoting/glob/input failures and projects improvement only against the frozen corpus.
entries.integration: Classify expected RED, protective refusal, model/input error, transport/auth/source drift, product defect and success separately; measure exact repairs on frozen inputs and live canaries.
entries.do_not_copy: No zero-error target, transferred benchmark percentage, or reliability claim before rebuild/relaunch/live observation.
entries.proof_required: Per-class counts, exact failure examples, mutation controls, new-generation live sample and no weakened safety tests.

entries.observed_shape: The audited project is MIT-licensed; inspected security documentation notes unsigned/unnotarized releases at that source window.
entries.mastermind_owner: existing supply-chain, release, host and security owners
entries.integration: Build from an exact source pin or independently verify an immutable artifact, preserve notices, produce SBOM/provenance, disable auto-update, and retain rollback.
entries.do_not_copy: No automatic upstream-main or binary update into live seats.
entries.proof_required: Reproducible or attributable build, dependency and vulnerability review, artifact signing/notarization strategy, update attack, rollback and secret-free logs.

recommended_first_experiment.name: disposable_read_only_local_workbench_falsifier
recommended_first_experiment.promotion_condition: Measured usefulness plus complete isolation, revocation, restart, persistence, secret, and cleanup proof; then propose one owner-specific component integration, not a wholesale production install.

exact_next_action: The existing worker/browser security and provider-runtime owners review this ledger and Packet 3, then either approve one pinned disposable read-only falsifier or record the specific unresolved owner/host/platform gate.
